title: 第135章 老祖宗，你到底哪边的？
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 魏渊听完魏海的话，也陷入了沉默。不是魏海说不清楚，肯定是沈园那边出现变故，发生了一些让人难以解释的事。而这难以解释的事，就是唐逸这家伙弄出来的，给暗京楼造成了巨大的杀伤。那应该就和陛下放出来的消息有关：唐逸在闭关练神功！这就是唐逸的神功。“知道了，将消息原封不动传回去吧！”片刻，魏渊挥了挥手，重新闭上了眼睛。魏海愣了一下，走近魏海低声道：“就这么将消息传回去？长公主可能不相信，而且今日的事情闹得这么大，消息传回去，唐逸就危险了。”“长公主不会允许陛下身边，出现这么大的助力的。”天香楼是公主府的产业，是京都最大的酒楼，其实就是长公主在京都设置的一个情报收集点。而负责人，就是魏渊。而长公主，是个野心勃勃一心想要当女帝的女人。如果当年不是炎文帝侥幸胜一筹登基，如今的大炎皇帝，可能就是这个女人了。魏渊没有丝毫的在意魏海的提醒，淡淡道：“她不在京都。”魏海脚下一个趔趄，差点给跪了，长公主不在京都，老祖宗你就这么随意的吗？“老祖宗，长公主虽然替陛下祭祖没回来，但京都都是她的耳目，咱们没查明就这么回复她？”“再说，公主已经在回来的路上了……”魏渊嘴角微扬，笑容嘲讽：“祭祖？她恨不得将先皇刨出来鞭尸，你觉得她会替陛下祭祖？”“她不过是找个借口出京都，暗中联络诸藩王罢了。”“这个女人，已经疯了！”魏海身体僵住，下意识看向周围。确定周围没有人靠近后，他才低声道：“师父，你到底哪边的？怎么一直都在帮陛下和唐逸说话？”“少废话”魏渊冷哼。他挥了挥手，道：“就直接按我说的办，其他的不用管，等她回到京都，京都可能就不是她所认识的京都了。”魏海怔住。就因为唐逸？就算唐逸很厉害，能一战灭掉暗京楼，但那是在暗京楼没有防备的情况下得手的。要是暗京楼不小觑唐逸，现在沈园说不定早就血流成河了。但老祖宗似乎对唐逸很有信心，觉得他能在京都对抗百官，对抗长公主？这怎么可能？虽然不知道老祖宗为何对唐逸这么有信心，但魏海还是拱了拱手，转身离开，按照获取的消息原封不动传给长公主。“爷爷，你……你为什么要帮唐逸？”一直没说话的女孩抬起头，看向魏渊。魏渊提起酒壶，往嘴里闷了一大口酒，没好气道：“为什么？因为你喜欢那小兔崽，我能不帮他？”女孩一双美眸顿时瞪大，俏脸也腾的一下红透了。“爷……爷爷，你胡说什么呀！”“我是喜欢他的诗，不是喜欢他的人。”见到孙女终于有了一点正常女孩该有的情绪，老太监嘴角渐渐泛起笑容。没关系的，只要灵儿喜欢就好。别说喜欢他的诗了，就是喜欢他的人又如何？只要你喜欢，爷爷帮你将他弄到床上，想怎么玩还不是你说了算。那小子敢不认账？哼，打死他！……幻音坊。梅香和秋菊正坐在一起聊天，自从得到小诗仙的两句诗后，她们的身价暴涨，足足翻了几十倍，不需要再像以前那么卑躬屈膝了。现在，都是老鸨求着她们开茶围，生怕她们一个不开心，将千万两银子往外推。“姐姐，姐姐，有消息了，有消息了……”这时，绿柳急匆匆地跑了进来。梅香和秋菊齐齐看向她，她们今日坐在一起，就是在等沈园诗会结束，再等一个结果。“怎么样？唐逸是不是小诗仙？”梅香下意识捏紧了手中的手帕。“是，姐姐猜得没错，唐逸就是小诗仙，唐逸真是小诗仙。”绿柳激动的俏脸泛红，挥舞着双手道。听到这话，梅香和绿竹都齐齐松了一口气，嘴角有了笑容。果然没猜错，唐逸就是小诗仙。哼哼，皇帝瞒得住所有人，却唯独没有瞒住他们。“他既然是小诗仙，那今日的沈园诗会，第一名非他莫属！”秋菊轻抿一口茶，等这个消息都等得她口干舌燥了。梅香也端起茶杯轻抿一口茶，嘴角含笑。“没错呢，他在沈园直接两首《钗头凤》，力压所有人。”绿柳俏脸激动，道：“最重要的是，陛下已经封他为忠勇侯，并且升他为三品京兆府尹，因为他一刀，杀了暗京楼一百多高手……”噗！梅香和秋菊嘴里的茶瞬间喷了出去。两人齐齐站了起来，声音都尖锐了几分：“你说什么？！”两人都脸色震惊，难以置信，唐逸竟然一刀杀了一半暗京楼的精锐？他武功竟然这么高？！绿竹被梅香和秋菊的反应吓了一跳，咽了咽口水道：“消息就是这么说的啊，现在街上都传遍了。”“你们……这么大反应干嘛？”秋菊和梅香这才察觉到自己失态了，迅速敛去脸上的情绪。梅香瞪了绿柳一眼，道：“废话，能不正经吗？那是暗京楼，你又不是不知道暗京楼是什么样的存在。”“唐逸竟然能一剑杀他们，那他得有多厉害？”秋菊微微抿唇，美眸中泛起一抹异彩：“之前他一夜御三女是假的，是咱们传出去的假消息。”“我觉得，这可以是真的。”梅香抿了抿唇，看向秋菊道：“我这里还有一壶千日醉，我记得你那里应该还有合欢散吧？”话落，两人齐齐看向绿柳，绿柳脸色一红，立即案首挺胸：“我藏有避子药！”梅香和秋菊一呆：“滚！”……南城，一间茅草屋中。院中鸡鸭成群，一个小女孩正站在院中喂鸡鸭，一边将情报汇报给站在门前的黑袍男人。听完女孩的回报，男人拍着胸口一副劫后余生的样子。“好险，好险，还好花钱让暗京楼去办这事了。”“要是咱们亲自出手，那现在咱们也死定了。”男人来回踱步，声音有点难以置信道：“失算了，失算了，这唐逸竟然这么厉害？”“你接下可咋整？接下来他的对手就是咱们了啊！”
content_en: Wei Yuan also fell silent after listening to Wei Hai's words.It's not that Wei Hai couldn't explain it clearly, there must have been changes at Shen Yuan's side, and something inexplicable happened.And this inexplicable thing was caused by Tang Yi, which caused huge damage to Anjing Tower.That should be related to the news released by His Majesty: Tang Yi is practicing magic in seclusion!This is Tang Yi's magical power."I know, please send the news back intact!" After a moment, Wei Yuan waved his hand and closed his eyes again.Wei Hai was stunned for a moment, then approached Wei Hai and said in a low voice: "Sending the news back just like this? The eldest princess may not believe it, and today's incident is such a big deal, Tang Yi will be in danger if the news is passed back." "The eldest princess will not allow such a big help to appear around your majesty." Tianxiang Tower is the property of the princess mansion and is the largest restaurant in Kyoto. In fact, it is an intelligence collection point set up by the eldest princess in Kyoto.The person in charge is Wei Yuan.The eldest princess is an ambitious woman who wants to be the empress.If Emperor Yan Wen hadn't succeeded by luck and ascended the throne, today's Emperor Dayan might have been this woman.Wei Yuan did not pay any attention to Wei Hai's reminder and said calmly: "She is not in Kyoto." Wei Hai staggered and almost knelt down. The eldest princess is not in Kyoto. Are you so casual, ancestor?"Old Ancestor, although the eldest princess has not come back to worship your majesty's ancestors, she is her eyes and ears in Kyoto. Why are we replying to her like this without finding out?" "Besides, the princess is already on her way back..." Wei Yuan raised the corner of his mouth slightly and smiled mockingly: "Sacrifice to our ancestors?She wants to exhume the late emperor and whip his corpse. Do you think she will worship his ancestors?"She just found an excuse to leave the capital and secretly contact the vassal kings.""This woman is crazy!"Wei Hai froze and looked around subconsciously.After making sure that no one was around, he whispered: "Master, where are you from? Why are you always helping His Majesty talk to Tang Yi?" "Stop talking nonsense," Wei Yuan snorted coldly.He waved his hand and said, "Just do as I say and don't worry about anything else. When she returns to Kyoto, Kyoto may not be the Kyoto she knows." Wei Hai was stunned.Just because of Tang Yi?Even if Tang Yi is very powerful and can destroy Anjing Tower in one battle, he only succeeds when Anjing Tower is unprepared.If An Jinglou had not underestimated Tang Yi, Shen Yuan might have been bleeding like a river by now.But the ancestor seems to have great confidence in Tang Yi, thinking that he can fight against the officials and the eldest princess in Kyoto?How is this possible?Although he didn't know why his ancestor had so much confidence in Tang Yi, Wei Hai still bowed his hand, turned around and left, passing the information to the eldest princess intact."Grandpa, you... why do you want to help Tang Yi?" The girl who had been silent raised her head and looked at Wei Yuan.Wei Yuan picked up the flask, took a sip of wine, and said angrily: "Why? Because you like that little rabbit, can I not help him?" The girl's beautiful eyes suddenly widened, and her pretty face turned red."Grandpa...Grandpa, what are you talking nonsense about?" "I like his poems, not his people." Seeing that his granddaughter finally had some emotions that a normal girl should have, the old eunuch gradually smiled at the corner of his mouth.It doesn't matter, as long as Ling'er likes it.Let alone liking his poems, what about people who like him?As long as you like it, grandpa will help you put him on the bed. It's not up to you to decide how you want to play with it.That boy dares not to admit it?Humph, beat him to death!...Huanyinfang.Mei Xiang and Qiu Ju were sitting and chatting together. Since receiving the two poems from Xiao Shixian, their values ​​have skyrocketed, dozens of times, and they no longer need to be as groveling as before.Now, it's all the madams who are begging them to open a tea party, fearing that none of them will be happy, so they will push away tens of millions of taels of silver."Sister, sister, there's news, there's news..." At this time, Luliu hurried in.Mei Xiang and Qiu Ju looked at her together. They were sitting together today, waiting for the end of Shen Yuan's poetry meeting and the result."How is it? Is Tang Yi a little poetry fairy?" Mei Xiang subconsciously squeezed the handkerchief in her hand."Yes, my sister guessed it right. Tang Yi is the Little Poet Fairy. Tang Yi is really the Little Poet Fairy." Luliu said with her pretty face flushed in excitement and waving her hands.Hearing this, Mei Xiang and Lu Zhu both breathed a sigh of relief and smiled.Sure enough, I guessed it right, Tang Yi is the Little Poet Fairy.Hum hum, the emperor could hide it from everyone, but he could not hide it from them."Since he is a little poetry fairy, he must be the first in today's Shen Yuan Poetry Club!" Qiu Ju took a sip of tea, her mouth was dry waiting for this news.Mei Xiang also picked up the tea cup and took a sip of tea, with a smile on her lips."That's right, he sang "The Hairpin Phoenix" directly in Shen Yuan, beating everyone else." Luliu's pretty face was excited and said: "The most important thing is that your Majesty has made him a Zhongyong Marquis and promoted him to the third rank Jingzhao Prefecture Yin, because he killed more than a hundred masters in the Anjing Tower with one sword..." Poof!The tea in Mei Xiang and Qiu Ju's mouths spurted out instantly.The two of them stood up together, their voices a bit sharp: "What did you say?!" Both of them looked shocked and unbelievable. Tang Yi actually killed half of the elite members of Anjing Tower with one knife?His martial arts is so high?!Lu Zhu was startled by Mei Xiang and Qiu Ju's reaction. She swallowed her saliva and said, "That's what the news said. Now it's spread all over the street." "Why...why are you reacting so big?" Qiu Ju and Mei Xiang realized that they had lost their composure and quickly suppressed the emotions on their faces.Mei Xiang glared at Lu Liu and said: "Nonsense, how can you be unserious? That's An Jing Tower. It's not like you don't know what kind of existence An Jing Tower is." "Tang Yi can actually kill them with one sword, so how powerful must he be?" Qiu Ju pursed her lips slightly, with a radiance in her beautiful eyes: "The fact that he had three girls in one night before was a lie. It was a fake news we spread." "II think this could be true." Mei Xiang pursed her lips and looked at Qiu Ju: "I still have a pot of Qianri Zui here.I remember that you should have Hehuan Powder, right?" After saying this, the two of them looked at Luliu, and Luliu's face turned red and he immediately raised his chest and said, "I have the anti-child medicine!" Mei Xiang and Qiu Ju were stunned: "Get out!"... In a thatched house in Nancheng.There are flocks of chickens and ducks in the courtyard. A little girl is standing in the courtyard feeding the chickens and ducks while reporting information to the man in black robe standing in front of the door.After hearing the girl's report, the man patted his chest as if he was surviving the disaster.“It’s so risky, so risky, it’s a good thing I paid An Jinglou to handle this matter.
title_en: Chapter 135: Ancestor, where are you from?
